LanguageData.PC_PEA.OpenDesc: Manage accounts, employment, shop stock and physical examinations.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.FaultHint: Unsupported or invalid ledger. Original payload is preserved; economic commands are stopped.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.AllocationHint: First activation allocates 1000.00 public credits once. Credits are internal, not silver. Disabling terminates economic contracts and releases reservations.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.ExamHint: Personal exams are self-paid; recruitment exams are publicly funded. Examiner needs Medicine 4+ and Doctor work enabled.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.SettleHint: Settle accrued production wages. Insufficient public funds suspend offers and contracts.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.StockHint: Select a hauler and stock a real garment. Each shop holds up to 64 items, preserving quality, durability and identity. Removing the counter drops its stock.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.ReportHint: Reports snapshot real capacities and visible conditions, without healing or revealing hidden illness. Valid for one day; live work and health restrictions still apply.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Rejected: Action rejected: stale view or unmet requirements. Check funds, hours, examiner, work settings and access.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Tab.EmptyHint: Nothing to show here yet; it appears once the corresponding action is done.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Policy.Title: Institution policy (wage and food quotes)
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Policy.Hint: The public owner declares what each institution publishes: bound workshop zone, wage per job, price per nutrition point, opening hours, open state and a free-stock target per product category. Zero means unpublished — never a zero price or a zero target; an institution without a bound zone publishes no position at all; every change is submitted with the revision it was read at, and a stale change is rejected.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Care.Title: Family and care (four-identity grants and service capability)
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Care.Hint: Beneficiary, guardian, executor and payer are four separate identities: a family relation never authorises a charge, only the explicitly recorded payer can be charged, and every charge stays inside the granted cap and validity window. A service may only take money once all seven gates are proven (vanilla access, delivery evidence, capacity and hours, price cap, settlement, interruption recovery, interface explanation); anything unproven keeps running on the vanilla public path and quotes no price.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Policy.ServicePriceHelp: Currently {0} silver per act. 0 means not offered (no charge, no settlement).
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Overview.Title: Economy overview (governance view)
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Overview.Note: This page reads published read models only: an unpublished quote stays "unpublished" and an unproven service stays "proving evidence" — nothing is filled in to look complete.

LanguageData.PC_PEA.Workspace.VanillaHint: Recognises the chopping / cutting / mining actions you issued and pays per completed piece from the treasury (names come from the vanilla work definitions, so same-source third-party content is covered too). Use the size buttons above to set how many pieces each contract covers: several job-seekers sign one contract each and work in parallel. Markers that already existed in older saves are not retroactive — issue them once more.
